description: Verify the current connection: owner.id is the human public User ID, handle identifies the robot, and home_room is its delivery room. After login or reconnect, match owner.id and handle to the approved account and robot before sending. A mismatch means stop and reload or restart the MCP client. Includes a credential-protected latest-pings feed and token-free install URL; never send credentials to the install URL.
name: connection_info

result.description: The authenticated robot and its owner public User ID, for account verification.

id.description: The human public User ID shown in PingRoom, not an internal database identifier.

title: Connection Info
